meta.name: Bedford Autodrome
meta.description: Bedford Autodrome, GT (5.9 km), SW (4.6 km), West (2.8 km) and SEN (3.6 km) circuits from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m). Flat, open airfield circuits with wide run-off amid Bedfordshire farmland.

kerbs.source: evo.co.uk Bedford corner-by-corner guide: some kerb can be taken at the apex of the Hangar Hairpin; running wide onto the concrete on the exit gains nothing
